caption_L1: This is a bar plot titled Monthly unemployment rate of men in the United States from November 2019 to November 2020 (seasonally adjusted). The y-axis measures Unemployment rate while the x-axis plots Month.
caption_L2L3: The monthly figures each cover four month oeriods, rather than each month of the years graphed. The highest unemployment figures on the chart are April and May, followed by June and July. The lowest unemployment figures are mid-winter, specifically November, December, January, February and March. The peak unemployment figure is just short of 0.14% and the minimum is 0.04%. There are five high months of unemployment, five low months of unemployment and three months of roughly average unemployment.
